The fixed edition path and clean paragraphs match the Ada 2022 manual. SHA-256 of the newly acquired full HTTPS response matches the source record. Paragraph 1 identifies simple entry calls. Paragraphs 8 and 12 specify the open/closed check and what follows a closed result. A closed entry at the check places the issued call in its queue. Selection and cancellation are separate ways a queued call can cease to be queued. The claim is confined to the simple entry call and the exact active Ada 2022 dynamic-semantics provisions. An open entry can be selected immediately. Select-statement variants or exceptions that prevent issuance do not establish a contrary result for the stated condition.
